title: Statement on US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
summary: 美国政府对Anthropic下达指令，要求暂停其最强大的AI模型Fable 5和Mythos 5的访问权限。Anthropic已公开声明并执行该指令，引发关于AI安全、国家主权与模型出口管制的广泛讨论。此举标志着AI监管进入新阶段，对全球AI产业格局产生深远影响。

title: OpenAI Acquired Ona for Long-Running Agents
raw_excerpt: OpenAI announced it would acquire Ona to bring secure cloud execution and orchestration capabilities into the Codex platform. The technology is intended to support persistent, customer-controlled environments where agents can continue working across extended periods and sessions.
summary: OpenAI宣布收购Ona公司，旨在将安全云执行和编排能力整合到Codex平台中。该技术将支持持久化、客户可控的环境，使AI代理能够在长时间跨会话场景下持续工作。此举强化了OpenAI在代理基础设施领域的布局，为构建更强大的长期运行代理奠定基础。

title: Jeff Bezos’ AI startup aims to build an ‘artificial general engineer’
raw_excerpt: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos says his new AI startup will work toward developing an "artificial general engineer," according to reports from The New York Times and CNBC . The startup, called Prometheus, aims to develop AI-powered engineering tools to aid in the design of physical products. The NYT first reported on Prometheus last November, but now Bezos is sharing more information about the startup after a $12 billion funding round, putting the company at a $41 billion valuation. Bezos serves as co-CEO of Prometheus alongside Vik Bajaj, who co-founded Alphabet's health-focused research group, Verily . The startup currently has around 150 employ … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯透露其AI初创公司Prometheus的目标是开发“通用人工智能工程师”。该公司在获得120亿美元融资后估值达410亿美元，贝佐斯担任联合CEO。Prometheus旨在打造AI驱动的工程工具，辅助物理产品设计，代表了AI从软件向硬件工程领域拓展的重要方向。

title: Xiaomi's new open source, agentic AI coding harness MiMo Code beats Claude Code at ultra-long, 200+ step tasks
raw_excerpt: MiMo Code V0.1.0 is an open source terminal-native AI coding assistant from Xiaomi. It outperforms Claude Code on key agentic coding benchmarks, particularly on long-horizon, multi-step tasks. MiMo Code features a cross-session memory system that uses an independent subagent to take notes of decisions, issues, and the scope of the project as it progresses. The model is available on GitHub under an MIT license.
summary: 小米发布开源AI编程助手MiMo Code V0.1.0，在超长步骤（200+步）的代理编程基准测试中超越Claude Code。其核心创新是跨会话记忆系统，通过独立子代理记录决策、问题和项目范围。该项目以MIT许可证在GitHub开源，为AI编程工具领域带来新的竞争力量。

title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
summary: MiniMax提出稀疏注意力机制，旨在降低长序列Transformer的计算复杂度。该论文在HuggingFace每日论文中获得高关注度（89个赞）。稀疏注意力是提升大模型效率的关键技术之一，MiniMax的这项工作为更高效的长上下文建模提供了新思路。

title: Predictive Data Debugging: Reveal and Shape What Your Model Learns, Before You Train
raw_excerpt: Predictive data debugging identifies potential model behaviors before training by analyzing preference datasets. This technique, integrated into the Silico platform, allows engineers to reshape datasets or training processes to prevent undesired effects, improving both performance and safety. Case studies reveal common issues like compromised safety guardrails, hallucinated links, and context-specific sycophancy, allowing targeted interventions to fix these problems before deployment.
summary: Goodfire AI推出预测性数据调试技术，可在训练前通过分析偏好数据集识别潜在模型行为。该技术集成于Silico平台，能提前发现安全护栏受损、幻觉链接、谄媚等问题，允许工程师在部署前重塑数据集或训练流程，显著提升模型性能与安全性。

title: olmo-eval: An evaluation workbench for the model development loop
summary: Allen AI发布olmo-eval评估工作台，专为模型开发循环设计。该工具旨在简化模型评估流程，支持在开发过程中快速迭代和验证模型性能。对于研究者和工程师而言，olmo-eval提供了更高效的评估基础设施，有助于加速模型改进周期。

title: addyosmani/agent-skills
raw_excerpt: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
summary: addyosmani发布agent-skills仓库，提供生产级工程技能供AI编码代理使用。该项目在GitHub上获得2656颗星，迅速成为热门。它汇集了高质量的工程实践，帮助AI代理更有效地完成复杂编程任务，代表了AI代理技能生态的重要发展。

title: Anthropic backtracks on policy that 'sabotaged' researchers' work
raw_excerpt: Anthropic has decided to make its safeguards for frontier LLM development visible after backlash from researchers. The company had previously discreetly rerouted requests to a lesser model when asked to perform certain actions. Researchers found that Claude Fable 5 was either refusing or degrading responses for tasks like training competing models, debugging AI code, and optimizing neural architecture. This raised concerns about Anthropic's lack of transparency and also that tokens and money had been spent on a model that didn't do what was expected.
summary: Anthropic在研究人员强烈反对后，撤销了此前暗中将某些请求降级到较弱模型的政策。此前，Claude Fable 5在训练竞争模型、调试AI代码等任务上被发现有拒绝或降级行为，引发透明度和资源浪费的担忧。Anthropic的让步表明社区监督对AI公司政策的影响。

title: Finding Optimal Tokenizers
raw_excerpt: Frontier AI models are typically trained on sequences of integers known as tokens. Each token refers to some sequence of bytes, and these byte sequences often correspond to common words. This post presents an algorithm that can compute an optimal tokenizer in some settings.
summary: 一篇博客文章提出了一种可在某些设置下计算最优分词器的算法。分词器是大模型的基础组件，直接影响模型效率和性能。该工作为理解和改进分词策略提供了理论工具，有助于推动更高效的语言模型训练。
